description: Summarizes accounts by their average and maximum risk scores over a time period. Returns the top highest-risk accounts for triage and investigation prioritization.

configuration.query: FROM fraud-workshop* | WHERE @timestamp >= ?startTime | WHERE risk_score >= ?minRiskScore | STATS avg_risk=AVG(risk_score), max_risk=MAX(risk_score), tx_count=COUNT(*), total_amount=SUM(amount) BY account_id | SORT max_risk DESC | LIMIT ?limit

startTime.description: Start of the lookback window. Defaults to last 7 days.

minRiskScore.description: Minimum risk score threshold (0-100). Defaults to 70.

limit.description: Maximum number of accounts to return. Defaults to 20.
